name: Harbor Dental
headline: Dentistry without the dread.
subhead: A calm practice where you get told what's happening, what it costs, and what your options are — before anything starts.

services.name: Check-ups & hygiene
services.text: A thorough exam, a clean, and a plain-English summary.

services.name: Cosmetic work
services.text: Whitening, veneers and bonding, with honest advice on what's worth doing.

services.name: Fillings & crowns
services.text: Same-day crowns where possible, so you're not walking around waiting.

services.name: Emergency care
services.text: Pain or a broken tooth? We keep slots free every day.

services.name: Children's dentistry
services.text: Gentle first visits designed so they'll happily come back.

services.name: Anxiety-aware care
services.text: Longer appointments and sedation options if you need them.

aboutText: Most people who walk in have put the visit off for years, and usually because of something that happened somewhere else. We work slowly, explain everything twice if you want, and never sell treatment you don't need.
reasons: No treatment recommended you don't need
